summary: Executed targeted backend regression (new retry + pending payment verification) and authenticated frontend 12-page coverage. Read flows pass, but authenticated UI mutations are blocked by origin guard (403), preventing full owner action validation in browser.

critical.issue: Browser-originated mutating requests fail with 403 'Untrusted request origin' (reproduced on /controls, /settings, /payments from authenticated UI). Same actions pass when called via Bearer requests without Origin header.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking actions shows toast 'Untrusted request origin'; no server-side state change (global stop alert never appears).
Pending payment creation/verification via UI blocked by same 403 origin error, so modal flow cannot complete in browser.
Saving settings from authenticated UI blocked by 403 origin guard; persistence checks cannot be completed via browser.

integration_issues.issue: All tested non-GET mutations from browser are blocked by origin validation despite authenticated owner session.

action_items: Fix origin validation for /api/bounty mutating routes so trusted frontend origin is accepted consistently.
Re-run authenticated browser mutation flows after fix: controls/global-stop, settings save/restore, payments create+verify modal.
After browser mutations work, re-validate full requested owner flow (OBSERVE gate + restore ASSISTED + payment modal assertions in UI).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py middleware checks Origin via exact string match and is rejecting valid frontend origin in practice. Normalize/validate robustly (e.g., strip whitespace, parse origin host/port, support expected variants) and log received origin for RCA.
Current policy effectively allows script/Bearer mutations with no Origin while blocking browser-originated mutations, which inverts expected security UX for owner dashboard operations.

success_rate.frontend: 70% (12/12 authenticated page navigation and read evidence passed; mutation flows blocked)

seed_data_creation: No owner identity/session changes. Created test-only pending payment attempts via UI, but mutations were blocked by origin guard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Authenticated shell and all 12 pages are reachable with owner session. Job evidence tabs (research/changes/tests/security/review/pr/audit) render correctly; retry button hidden on non-NEEDS_REVIEW job (PAID). Core blocker is 403 'Untrusted request origin' on browser non-GET requests.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: authenticated browser on preview URL, click any mutation action (security controls, global stop confirm, save settings, record payment). UI toast returns 'Untrusted request origin'; network response 403. Backend middleware at server.py lines 1160-1163 enforces origin allowlist for non-GET /api/bounty and rejects runtime Origin. Cross-check: same endpoints pass in pytest/requests when Authorization header is used and Origin header omitted; sending explicit Origin header causes 403. Mitigation: fix/normalize allowed-origin matching at runtime and preserve strict trusted-origin checks without breaking first-party browser requests.
